description: Manage Zep users, conversation threads, messages, and graph context.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Zep API key sent as Authorization: Api-Key <api_key>. Create or copy a key from your Zep project's settings after signing in at https://app.getzep.com.

actions.name: add_thread_messages
actions.description: Add chat messages to a Zep thread, ingest them into the user's graph, and optionally return current context.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the target thread.

content.description: The message content, limited to 4,096 characters.

role.description: The role of the message sender.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to a Zep resource.

name.description: The customizable name of the message sender.

processed.description: Whether Zep has processed the message.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the message.

items.description: A message to add to a Zep conversation thread.

messages.description: The messages to add in chronological order.

items.description: The role of the message sender.

ignore_roles.description: The roles to retain as messages but ignore for graph-memory extraction.

return_context.description: Whether to return context relevant to the most recent messages.

strict_ontology.description: Whether to prevent extraction of generic entities that do not match the configured ontology.

inputSchema.description: The input for adding messages to a Zep thread and its user graph.

context.description: The context relevant to the most recent messages, when requested.

message_uuids.description: The unique identifiers assigned to the added messages.

task_id.description: The identifier of the upstream graph-processing task.

outputSchema.description: The result of adding messages to a Zep thread.

actions.name: create_thread
actions.description: Create a conversation thread for an existing Zep user.

thread_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the thread.

user_id.description: The identifier of the existing user associated with the thread.

inputSchema.description: The input for creating a Zep thread.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the thread was created.

project_uuid.description: The unique identifier of the thread's Zep project.

thread_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the thread.

user_id.description: The application-defined identifier of the associated user.

user_uuid.description: The opaque identifier of the associated user.

uuid.description: The opaque unique identifier of the thread.

actions.name: create_user
actions.description: Create a Zep user that can own conversation threads and graph memory.

user_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

first_name.description: The first name of the user.

last_name.description: The last name of the user.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to a Zep resource.

anyOf.description: The user's IANA time zone. Null leaves it unset at creation or clears it on update.

time_zone.description: The user's IANA time zone. Null leaves it unset at creation or clears it on update.

disable_default_ontology.description: Whether to disable the default ontology for the user's graph.

inputSchema.description: The input for creating a Zep user.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the user was created.

anyOf.description: The timestamp when the user was deleted, or null for an active user.

deleted_at.description: The timestamp when the user was deleted, or null for an active user.

disable_default_ontology.description: Whether the default ontology is disabled for the user's graph.

id.description: The internal numeric identifier of the user.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to a Zep resource.

project_uuid.description: The unique identifier of the user's Zep project.

session_count.description: The deprecated session count returned by Zep when present.

anyOf.description: The IANA time zone, or null when no time zone is set.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone, or null when no time zone is set.

updated_at.description: The deprecated user update timestamp returned by Zep when present.

user_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the user.

uuid.description: The opaque unique identifier of the user.

actions.name: delete_thread
actions.description: Delete a Zep conversation thread and its thread-specific memory.

thread_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the thread.

inputSchema.description: The input identifying a Zep thread.

message.description: The acknowledgement message returned by Zep.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Delete a Zep user and the threads and graph artifacts associated with that user.

user_id.description: The application-defined unique identifier of the user.

inputSchema.description: The input identifying a Zep user.

message.description: The acknowledgement message returned by Zep.

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Retrieve the Zep project associated with the connected API key.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require input.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the project was created.

anyOf.description: The IANA time zone, or null when no time zone is set.

default_time_zone.description: The IANA time zone, or null when no time zone is set.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the project.

actions.name: get_thread_context
actions.description: Retrieve the most relevant context from a user's graph for the current Zep thread.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the current thread.

template_id.description: The optional context template identifier used for rendering.

inputSchema.description: The input for retrieving assembled user context for a Zep thread.

context.description: The context block containing relevant facts, entities, and messages from the user graph.

actions.name: get_thread_messages
actions.description: Retrieve messages from a Zep thread with cursor or recent-message controls.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the target thread.

limit.description: The maximum number of messages to return.

lastn.description: The number of most recent messages to return, overriding limit and cursor.

inputSchema.description: The input for retrieving messages from a Zep thread.

role.description: The role of the message sender.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to a Zep resource.

name.description: The customizable name of the message sender.

processed.description: Whether Zep has processed the message.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the message.

items.description: A message in a Zep conversation thread.

messages.description: The messages returned for the thread.

total_count.description: The total number of messages in the thread.

user_id.description: The application-defined identifier of the thread's user.

user_uuid.description: The opaque identifier of the thread's user.

outputSchema.description: A paginated Zep thread message response.
